Definition: from G1537 and G4429; to spit out, i.e. (figuratively) spurn:--reject.
BiblicalUsage: The word ekptýō carries the sense of reject. In Galatians 4:14, the text says "nor rejected."
TheologicalSignificance: I read ekptýō plainly — it means reject, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
